summary: Persist Topnet continuation and bind bank return to the first owner authorization without replaying FORM1.
reason: Controlled live acceptance reached one FORM1 dispatch but lost actionable correlation after the PSP response. The runtime must persist checkout/order internally and let the exact bank return perform one read-only resume.

tests.name: payment-core
tests.evidence: 44/44 Payment Core assertions passed including one-shot bank-return resume.

tests.name: topnet-live-adapter
tests.evidence: 6/6 adapter tests passed; resume performs no card-status read and consumes no new live gate.

tests.name: payment-api-registry
tests.evidence: Owner confirmation payment API and registry checks passed with Termux-private TMPDIR.

tests.name: runtime-deployment
tests.evidence: Companion restarted from the published runtime, reports connected, exposes bank-return, and keeps realPaymentsEnabled false with Topnet unavailable by default.

capabilities.reason: Canonical capability truth and registry updates are delivered in samantha-ui-playbooks; this repository contains only the matching Companion runtime implementation.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Payment Core and Companion routes only; no new service, database or scheduler.

rollback: Revert this scoped commit with the live Topnet gate absent. Do not replay any previously engaged payment request.
limitations: Topnet live remains disabled by default.
Issuer authentication remains human and is never captured by Companion.
A positive live receipt still requires separate controlled acceptance.
